records.name: Community Network Services
records.summary: A nonprofit that teaches basic computer and online skills and gives donated laptops and computers to people who need them.
records.what_you_do: Take a basic computer class (email, web browsing, job search help), donate a device, or volunteer through the Volunteer page on the site.

first_step.how: Email info@comnetworkservices.org or call (267) 881-6553 to ask about the next computer class
first_step.basis: Training is open to all ages and backgrounds, but the site lists no sign-up steps, only contact details

records.notes: No dated events, news or posts on the site. The only year is a footer copyright, which is not evidence. The Volunteer page is linked (/volunteer) but was not read. The IRS address, 6512 Saybrook Ave 19142, is not shown on the site, so no location is recorded. Training cost is not stated.

records.name: Law Enforcement Mentor Club
records.summary: A mentoring club for at-risk young people that uses sports, music and art to help build trust between young people and law enforcement officers.
records.what_you_do: Take part in mentoring activities built around sports, music and art. The site also asks visitors to donate or sign up for its newsletter.

first_step.how: Use the Contact page on the club's site, or message its Instagram account, to ask how a young person or an officer can take part
first_step.basis: The site does not say how people join, and its email address is hidden behind protection code

records.notes: The site says the club was founded in 2020 by its director. The news page lists four press items about a peace march, but they carry no dates and the page does not say the club organized them. The banner 'Leading the Way for 4 Years' is undated. The email address is hidden by protection code and was not decoded. The IRS address, 8212 Buist Ave 19153, is not shown on the site. Ages served are not stated.

records.name: Rising Hope for Change
records.summary: A nonprofit that offers humanitarian help, plus education and training programs, for people in need who want to reach their goals.
records.what_you_do: Apply for help through the Beneficiary Application page, or find out how to get involved through the Get Involved page.

first_step.how: Email info@rhfc.info or call 267-969-8729 to ask about help or about getting involved
first_step.basis: The site has an application for people who need help and a Get Involved page, but does not say what joining looks like

records.notes: The News page has an introduction saying events and training will be posted, but no posts follow, so no dated item was found. The Events and Promo page was not read. The eligibility rules are on the Beneficiary Application page, which was not read. The IRS address, 6101 Grays Ave 19142, is not shown on the site.

records.name: Sharing Excess
records.summary: A food rescue nonprofit that collects surplus food from businesses and passes it on to communities in need. It is rooted in Philadelphia and now works in many states.
records.what_you_do: Volunteer through the site's Volunteer page, donate money or food, or, if you run a community group, request food through the Find Food page.

cost.text: Volunteering costs nothing. Donations are optional and start at $5.

first_step.how: Sign up through the Volunteer page at sharingexcess.com, then ask which shifts are open, since the site lists no shift dates
first_step.basis: Volunteer sign-up is open on the site, but the page does not list shifts or event dates

records.notes: The website lists EIN 86-2161466, which matches the IRS record. The newest dated item on the news page is from August 11, 2026, and covers a record-setting food donation day. Earlier items run back to 2024. The IRS address, 6700 Essington Ave Ste E207 19153, is not shown on the site, so no location is recorded. The Volunteer page was not read beyond its link.

records.name: Oromo Community Organization of Pennsylvania
records.summary: A nonprofit for Oromo people in Pennsylvania that keeps Oromo language and culture alive, holds a yearly get-together, and offers community support services.
records.what_you_do: Come to the yearly get-together and other community events, or send a suggestion or request through the Contact Us form on the site.

schedule.text: Holds an annual get-together; the site does not give a date

first_step.how: Send a message through the Contact Us form on oromopa.org to ask about the next community get-together
first_step.basis: The site does not say who may join, and its Get Involved buttons lead nowhere yet

records.notes: The site has no dated events, news or announcements. Its copyright line says 2025, which is not evidence, and image file names with 2025 dates are not announcements. Other phone numbers on the site: 717-380-6062, 267-721-1107 and 267-231-6819. The site does not state membership rules, so open_to is public with low confidence. The IRS name is The Oromo Community Organization of Pennsylvania. The heritage tag is ethiopian because the site's aid work is for Oromos in Ethiopia, and no closer tag exists.

records.name: Trinity Kristen School of the Arts
records.summary: A dance school for kids, teens and adults, with classes in ballet, hip-hop, tap, jazz and modern. The school says no experience is needed to start.
records.what_you_do: Take a dance class. Kids and teens can try ballet, hip-hop, tap, jazz or modern. Adults can join hip-hop, Zumba, heels, pole, ballet or jazz classes.

cost.text: Registration fee is $30 online, or $20 for early bird registration by September 1 (2026 to 2027 season). A sibling discount of $20 is offered. Monthly tuition is not listed on the page.

first_step.how: Use the Sign Up Now link on the price list page at trinitykschoolofarts.org/price-list, or ask through Contact Us about a trial class
first_step.basis: The school says no prior experience is needed and lists a sign-up link; no trial class is listed

records.notes: This is a paid dance school whose classes are open to the public. It is kept as publish because a class is its public way in, per the arts rule, but the owner may want to decide whether paid dance schools count as community groups. The IRS name is Trinity Kristen School of the Arts Corporation; kind is set to program because the group is a school. The homepage copyright year (2024) is not evidence. The 2026 to 2027 fee page is the newest sign of life, with no month shown, so status is probably_active. social_dance is the closest tag under the brief's rule, since no tag names ballet or tap. Summer camp and hours pages were not read. The IRS address, 6508 Woodland Ave 19142, is not shown on the site.

records.name: Christian Legal Clinics of Philadelphia
records.summary: Volunteer attorneys give legal help on housing, child custody, domestic abuse, wills and record clearing at clinics around the region. The group calls itself an urban legal ministry.
records.what_you_do: Lawyers can sign up on the Volunteer Opportunities page. People who need legal help can schedule a consultation from the Get Help page.

first_step.how: Schedule a consultation from the Get Help page for legal help, or sign up on the Volunteer Opportunities page to give help
first_step.basis: The consultation and volunteer sign-up links are public, but the site does not say who qualifies for help

records.notes: The news listing shows a Doylestown Dinner on June 9, 2026 and a Prayer Walk on June 20, 2026. An earlier read of the homepage showed only the year 2026 for these, so please check the news page before relying on the June dates. Mailing address: P.O. Box 2907, Philadelphia PA 19141. Clinic sites: West Philadelphia, Hunting Park, South Philadelphia West and East, Delaware County, Germantown, and New Hope. Delaware County and New Hope are outside the city, so in_city is not set. The faith field is empty because no single faith tag fits; the site describes itself as an urban legal ministry.
